raw:
@s1 stated
  relation "deliver for"
  role subject "the user"
  role object "Glovo"
  role location "Constanța"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted
  valid from "approximately two months ago"

@q query
  select ?x
  where all
    match
      relation "be in"
      role subject ?x
      role object "the user's group"
      polarity affirmed
    end
    match
      relation "work for"
      role subject ?x
      role object "Glovo"
      polarity affirmed
    end
  end
